versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the aesthetic-builder skill.
- Supports dual modes: independent aesthetic system creation and shared style extraction from Character Builder roles.
- Implements a 9-dimension, 3-layer interactive model (perceptual, emotional, and cultural layers) with explicit handling of dimension interactions.
- Integrates with the meta-skill-system execution framework for structured, executable aesthetic outputs.
- Provides systematic workflows, degradation strategies, and strict fact disciplines to ensure reliability and traceability.
- Outputs comprehensive aesthetic Skill files with three-part reference structure and prompt export capabilities.
